title: M365DeprecationScanner rule database
description: List of deprecated or retired Microsoft 365 / Entra / Azure PowerShell commands, parameters, modules and endpoints.

id.description: Stable, unique rule id. Prefix by area, e.g. MSOL0001. Never reuse or renumber an id.

kind.description: Command = a cmdlet/function name. Parameter = a parameter on a specific command. Module = Import-Module / Install-Module / #Requires -Modules. StringLiteral = a regex matched against string literals (URLs, endpoints).

pattern.description: Command/Parameter/Module: name, may contain * and ? wildcards (case-insensitive). StringLiteral: a .NET regular expression (case-insensitive).

exclude.description: Command/Module rules only: names (wildcards allowed) the pattern must NOT match, e.g. valid cmdlets caught by a broad catch-all.

command.description: Required when kind = Parameter: the command (wildcards allowed) the parameter belongs to.

area.description: Product area, used for grouping in reports.

module.description: The legacy module the matched item comes from.

status.description: Retired = no longer works. Deprecated = still works but end of support/retirement announced or passed. Announced = retirement announced for the future.

retirementDate.description: Date the item stops/stopped working (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). Omit if unknown.

title.description: One short sentence describing the problem.

replacement.description: What to use instead (command, module or approach).

notes.description: Migration hints: parameter differences, permission scopes, output object changes.

sources.description: Official URLs backing this rule. Prefer learn.microsoft.com / techcommunity.microsoft.com.
